entities.summary: Manghit, a notable figure in the history of Tajikistan, associated with Bukharan and Kokand Khanate Period (1740–1868). Preceded by Emirate of Bukhara and Pamir Autonomy and Uzbek Shaybanid. Their legacy influenced Russia establishes protectorate over the Emirate of Bukhara.
